name: Bitbucket
label: Bitbucket Cloud REST 2.0
description: Bitbucket Cloud REST 2.0. Docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/ pr_create takes title, source {branch:{name}}, destination {branch:{name}}, description. pr_merge takes type, message, merge_strategy, close_source_branch. pipeline_run takes target + variables. Auth: HTTP Basic email + access_token (app password).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official Bitbucket Cloud 2.0 verb. EXACT: repo_get | repo_list | file_get | pr_create | pr_get | pr_merge | pipeline_run | pipeline_get | commit_list | listen. Example: pr_create.

schema.label: workspace
schema.description: Workspace slug (path). Example: acme.

schema.label: repo_slug
schema.description: Repository slug (path). Example: api.

schema.label: path
schema.description: file_get file path. Example: README.md.

schema.label: commit
schema.description: file_get commit/revision. Example: main.

schema.label: pagelen
schema.description: Page size for repo_list / commit_list. Example: 25.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Page number for repo_list / commit_list. Example: 1.

schema.label: q
schema.description: repo_list query filter. Example: name="api".

schema.label: title
schema.description: pr_create body `title`. Example: Fix login timeout.

schema.label: source
schema.description: pr_create official source {branch:{name}}. Example: {"branch":{"name":"feature/login"}}.

schema.label: destination
schema.description: pr_create official destination {branch:{name}}. Example: {"branch":{"name":"main"}}.

schema.label: description
schema.description: pr_create body `description` (markdown).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Pull request id for pr_get / pr_merge. Example: 42.

schema.label: target
schema.description: pipeline_run official target {type, ref_type, ref_name} or {type: pipeline_commit_target, commit:{hash, type}}. Example: {"type":"pipeline_ref_target","ref_type":"branch","ref_name":"main"}.

schema.label: pipeline_uuid
schema.description: pipeline_get path UUID (with braces). Example: {1a2b-…}.

schema.label: include
schema.description: commit_list query `include` (ref to include, e.g. a branch). Example: master.

schema.label: exclude
schema.description: commit_list query `exclude` (ref to exclude). Example: develop.

schema.label: close_source_branch
schema.description: pr_create / pr_merge `close_source_branch`. Example: true.

schema.label: type
schema.description: pr_merge body `type` (must be pullrequest). Example: pullrequest.

schema.label: message
schema.description: pr_merge commit message.

schema.label: merge_strategy
schema.description: pr_merge `merge_strategy`. EXACT: merge_commit | squash | fast_forward. Example: squash.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: pipeline_run body `variables`: [{key, value, secured}].

schema.label: role
schema.description: repo_list query `role`. EXACT: owner | admin | contributor | member.

schema.label: pull_request_id
schema.description: Pull request id for pr_get / pr_merge (alias of path id). Example: 42.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: repo_get, repo_list, file_get, pr_create, pr_get, pr_merge, pipeline_run, pipeline_get, commit_list, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Atlassian API token (app passwords retired 2026-07-28). Basic auth with Atlassian account email. OAuth Bearer is an alternative the engine cannot switch at runtime — prefer API token.

configurationParameters.label: Email
configurationParameters.description: Atlassian account email (Basic username). Not the Bitbucket username.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Pull Request Id
configurationParameters.description: Pull request id for pr_get / pr_merge (alias of path id). Example: 42.
